I’m Gabe Vandevere — a senior studying computer science at the University of Delaware, living in Wayne, Pennsylvania, just outside Philadelphia. By day I’m at The RxAssistant, building and testing conversational-AI products for pharmaceutical clients. Before that I did R&D at Westpepper Capital: backtesting pipelines, real-time crypto market data on AWS, and a trading strategy that made it to production. I like small machines doing big jobs — which is why this page, and the model you can talk to below, run on a Jetson on my desk.

02 / work

In climbing a project is the one you haven’t sent yet — the thing you keep coming back to until it goes. Three of mine, and on purpose no two are the same kind of problem.

012026HenHacks

Savor

Receipt-scanning pantry tracker that surfaces food before it expires.

Next.js and TypeScript on Supabase, with Google Gemini’s vision model handling receipt OCR. Scanned items become a typed inventory with expiry dates; recipes are ranked by what is closest to expiring, and the app tracks cumulative waste avoided in dollars and CO₂. Built by a team of four over one weekend at HenHacks 2026 and deployed on DigitalOcean.

022026research

Dog gait analysis

Detects cranial cruciate ligament injury from video of a dog walking.

Two stages: a pose cascade tracks 39 body keypoints and 46 facial landmarks per frame, cutting mean normalised landmark error 28.6% against the previous single-model approach (PCK@5% 71.0% to 84.1%, 479 held-out images). Those joint trajectories become gait features for a random-forest classifier trained on 12 GB of clinical video. Output is a CCL probability and a pose-overlaid render of the input for review.

  • PyTorch
  • DeepLabCut
  • scikit-learn
  • OpenCV
  • Python

032026Raspberry Pi

Oracle

Minecraft server on a Raspberry Pi with an autonomous chat agent.

Paper server on a Raspberry Pi 4B, exposed over an outbound tunnel rather than port forwarding and managed by systemd so the world saves before a restart. Oracle is a Java plugin that reads all public chat with no command prefix: an interest scorer rates every message 0–100, and it replies only when the score clears a threshold and a cooldown has elapsed. The inference provider — Claude, Gemini, or llama.cpp on the Jetson — is switchable at runtime.

  • Java
  • Paper API
  • Raspberry Pi
